findings.text: The company was incorporated on 22 June 2004 and its status is recorded as active.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts are not overdue; they were last made up to 31 December 2024 and the next are due 31 December 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 26 June 2026 and the next is due 10 July 2027.
There are 3 current officers: 2 directors, PERSON 555 (appointed 28 April 2026) and PERSON 556 (appointed 16 October 2023), and 1 other officer.
Since 24 October 2025, PERSON 555 was appointed as a director on 28 April 2026 and PERSON 563 resigned as a director on 26 May 2026.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2111, a company holding 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights with the right to appoint and remove directors.
Across the 2 current directors checked, 50 other companies were found (44 active, 6 dissolved), and this may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.
